about: The Sketcher task panel's Constraints and Elements boxes and the edit-mode commands around them (ui/src/sketchpanels.tsx, sketchpanelcmds.ts), run on the real FreeCAD (fcsketch.py --cases) and on the workbench (sketchcheck.mjs --suite panels). A "panel" step acts on a list: a row ("row": its index; "mod": "ctrl" or "shift"; an element's "sub": edge, start, end, mid or label), its "check" box, a double click, its context menu's entry ("menu", "record": what the menu holds), "rename" (F2 or the editor a double click opened, the text, Return), a click on the list's empty part, the filter's items ("filter", "checked"), its check box ("filterBox"), the Settings menu's actions ("setting") and the Show/Hide button. "msgbox": the button pressed in a question the case asks. "check": "panel" compares what the lists show and the selection, "state" each constraint's name, driving, active and virtual space states and its expression.

cases.name: el-shift
cases.known: Shift takes the rows between the last pressed and the hovered one (itemEntered); FreeCAD's GUI under fcsketch_dump.py's synthetic events never reports the hover, so it selects only the two rows
